question: What dual attainment in this world and beyond rewards the completed vow?
premises: The vow has been properly completed.
Enjoyment and liberation are named as attainments.
These attainments span this world and the next.
inference: Completion of the vow yields both enjoyment and liberation in this world and beyond.
plain_english: One indeed obtains both enjoyment and liberation, in this world and in the next.
